title: Autogen core quickstart guide fails about half the time
body:
[This guide](https://microsoft.github.io/autogen/dev/user-guide/core-user-guide/quickstart.html) will fail something like half the time. 

The problem is that a python package is missing, and when the LLM instructs autogen to install the package, it doesn't include the code its supposed to run along with the install command. This causes the package to be installed, but no code to actually be executed.

The same thing can happen if there are multiple rounds of this interaction, where any round that doesn't include the actual python code will cause the task to fail

linked_prs.title: Fix one failure mode in the user guide
linked_prs.body:
## Why are these changes needed?

The user guide will often fail because the LLM does not provide all the code required to solve the problem in a single response

## Related issue number

Resolves #4645

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue because it involves tool invocation failures where the LLM instructs the agent to install a package but fails to include the necessary code for execution, leading to task failures. This aligns with "Misuse tool interfaces" under Tool-related issues.
